title: Orsen and the Hollow
premise: Theo Vane, youngest smuggler of the Hollow Guild, discovers his name and tonight's date inked in a century-old prophecy hidden in the guild's ledger vault. The prophecy names him the 'Hollow-Bearer' who must carry a sealed truth — that the guild's founding charter was stolen from the mountain's exiled fae wardens — across Thornfell before winter closes the passes. Hunted by both the corrupt Guildmaster who wants the secret buried and the wardens who want it screamed from the peaks, Theo must choose between loyalty to the only family he's known and the truth that could free or destroy them all. He delivers the truth to the wardens, but bargains a mercy clause: the guild is exiled rather than exterminated, and Theo walks out of the mountains alone into the long winter, belonging to no one but finally honest.
about_author: D. M. Nystrom is the pen name of a former trail guide who spent six winters in the northern ranges and now writes fantasy about people who know the mountains too well. Their work explores what loyalty costs when the truth arrives too late to be painless.

chapters.title: The Ledger Vault
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Sent to inventory the guild's sealed archive as punishment for a botched run, Theo finds a prophecy book whose final entry names him and tonight's date. Before he can decide whether it's forgery or fate, Guildmaster Corvess catches him reading — and instead of punishing him, quietly locks the vault and doubles Theo's guard duty. Beat: dread disguised as routine; the moment ordinary life becomes a trap.

chapters.title: What the Charter Owes
chapters.summary: Theo's POV, with an interlude in the wardens' voice. Theo breaks back into the vault and learns the truth: the guild's charter was stolen from the fae wardens a century ago, and the prophecy demands its return before first snow. Corvess's enforcer catches him fleeing with the charter; Theo escapes over the smuggler's roads only he knows, wounded and hunted by his own family. Beat: betrayal — loyalty curdling as he realizes the guild was built on theft.

chapters.title: First Snow on Thornfell
chapters.summary: Alternating POV: Theo and Corvess. Theo crosses the high passes through the season's first blizzard, guided by a half-trusted warden scout named Ilen who tests him with illusions drawn from his own guilt. Corvess leads the guild's hunters up the same road, willing to kill the boy he raised rather than let the charter reach the wardens' court. They collide at the pass; Theo refuses to hand over the charter even at knifepoint. Beat: climax — the choice made, loyalty broken open.

chapters.title: The Long Winter
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. At the wardens' court beneath the ice, Theo speaks the truth and invokes the prophecy's mercy clause: exile for the guild, not slaughter. The wardens agree; Corvess, defeated and exposed, is stripped of power rather than killed — a mercy Theo insists on. The guild scatters into the lowlands, and Theo, no longer Hollow-Bearer nor truly guild, walks down out of Thornfell as snow seals the passes behind him. Beat: bittersweet resolution — truth won, belonging lost, integrity intact.
